title: Where I've built.
sub: Across startups, enterprises, and everything in between.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Owned end-to-end development of features for Nym4Business, a multi-tenant B2B financial platform serving SMEs and organizations.
Developed a configurable transaction approval system supporting conditional rules, multi-level approvals, and role/user based authorization.
Implemented two-factor authentication, audit-logging mechanisms, and card-issuing workflows integrated with NymCard's core payment systems.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Developed core backend services powering Korn Ferry Talent Suite, a global HR-Tech platform serving thousands of organizations across 150+ countries.

Engineered an internal service-discovery and request-routing system that periodically scanned services, aggregated route maps, and dynamically translated outgoing requests, reducing inter-service latency by up to 70% and overall request latency by up to 40%, without requiring changes to individual service handlers.

Architected a real-time streaming export pipeline for multi-gigabyte audit logs, generating and streaming CSV exports directly to clients without intermediate server-side files, minimizing memory consumption and eliminating generated-file storage overhead.

Designed an advanced hierarchical request-tracing system capturing nested execution flows, operation-level timings, and contextual metadata across database and HTTP calls, with minimal overhead in request-processing pipelines.

roles.title: Founding Engineer & Tech Lead
bullets: Led the engineering of a two-sided marketplace platform from initial design through production launch, owning core backend and frontend architecture while leading a team of three.

Designed a dynamic inheritance-based CMS with a hierarchical category system, allowing categories and subcategories to be created with independently configurable listing attributes, pricing packages, and limits, while inheriting or selectively overriding parent configurations.

Engineered a hybrid geospatial and address-based search system using MongoDB geospatial queries and custom distance calculations to support map-based discovery, radius searches, and structured address filtering.
Built a real-time communication system using Socket.IO, with per-listing chat rooms, custom presence tracking, reconnection handling, typing indicators, media messaging, and real-time notifications.
Architected a Stripe-integrated wallet and recurring payments system, implementing a hybrid transaction ledger supporting direct payments, account credits, and automated subscription renewals.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Mentored 100+ developers worldwide, providing technical guidance across software engineering, full-stack development, and system design, from foundational programming to advanced engineering concepts.
Designed and delivered end-to-end full-stack applications across the TypeScript and JavaScript ecosystems, spanning React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, and more.
Delivered products across diverse domains, including gaming companion applications, tournament management platforms, educational technology, and more.
